minutes.headline: Board found technical hours violations at Mickey Shays twice, issued written warnings, and set the 2-day suspension for Feb 14-15.
minutes.summary: The board first set the dates for a previously imposed two-day license suspension after the owner dropped his appeal. It then heard two liquor license hearings on after-hours incidents, finding a violation of the hours-of-operation rule in each and issuing a warning. The town manager reported on the solar net-metering change, Eagle Heights, grants, and an insurance award.

budget_items.topic: Solar net metering credits / cash payments
budget_items.what_was_said: Because the Chase Road project is Class III, Unitil will pay the town cash rather than credits, and the town passes most of it to the developer and keeps a discount share.
The town gets premium credits back from its insurer for training, used to fund extra training, including for police.
figures_as_heard: ten or eleven thousand dollars per year

budget_items.topic: Eagle Heights concessions: connection and permit fees
budget_items.what_was_said: Developer sought waivers of sewer/water connection and building permit fees and a PILOT; the sewer commission cannot waive fees it passes through.
The town applied for two district local technical assistance grants through MRPC, paid to MRPC to do work on the town's behalf, including regional animal control feasibility.
The finance committee will take up a deficit spending authorization for snow and ice.

decisions.decision: No special meeting next week; warrant for annual town meeting to be opened at the first February meeting with the schedule.
Town manager to send the capital planning priority list to the board before the budget recommendation.
Building reuse committee future to be put on a February agenda.
Mickey Shays suspension dates confirmed and to be notified by mail.
Board interested in a workshop/training on liquor license enforcement; town counsel willing to help.
Next meeting set for Tuesday February 4, 2014; board to reach out to planning board on communication.

what_happened.line: The Select Board found a violation of the hours-of-operation rule at Mickey Shays for the Nov 1 incident and issued a written warning on a 3-2 vote.
The board found a violation of the hours-of-operation rule for the Dec 15 incident at Mickey Shays and issued a warning.
The board set the two-day Mickey Shays license suspension for Friday Feb 14 and Saturday Feb 15, 2014, to be notified by mail.
The town manager reported that, because the Chase Road solar project is Class III, Unitil will pay the town cash rather than credits, most of it passed to the developer.
The board approved amusement device and weekday entertainment licenses for Prime Time Pub, and deferred the annual town meeting warrant to the first February meeting.

why_it_matters: The Mickey Shays rulings and suspension dates show how the town enforces closing-hour rules for licensed establishments, and the board's interest in enforcement training may shape how future hearings are handled.

The solar payment arrangement, the Eagle Heights request to waive fees and seek a PILOT, and the snow and ice deficit all bear on the town budget, mostly taxes, and on what the annual town meeting warrant will ask voters to approve.
watch_next: The next meeting is Tuesday, February 4, 2014, when the annual town meeting warrant is to be opened with the schedule.
The finance committee is to take up a deficit spending authorization for snow and ice.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The records agree on the main outcomes: the Primetime Pub licenses, the Feb 14–15 suspension, both violation findings and both warnings, and the solar and warrant figures. They differ on the first hearing's "no violation" motion and on the vote counts, which our record gives only for the written warning. Names are mostly caption errors.
